mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the star wheel brought the perforated disc and projecting shaft together in the box, making the construction easier to picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the collar was clear but a small, predictable step on its own.

surprise.text: The punched stars appeared as tiny holes arranged around the disc, rather than explicitly star-shaped holes.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the fittings followed clear goals, though I followed the offered actions rather than discovering their compatibility.

continue.text: I would be curious to see the projector work, but the mostly single-option fittings alone are not a strong reason for me to continue into another chapter.
